# DOT HAZMAT Transportation Supervisor Training for Highway

> 7-hour online training for supervisors and managers who oversee the preparation, handling or transport of hazardous materials by highway, based on the DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations, 49 CFR Parts 171-180. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 7 hours; 9 modules, 19 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.7 CEU
- Price: $219.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and client-site formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none (basic hazmat knowledge or prior hazmat employee training helps)
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years
- Drivers need their own hazmat employee training; this course is designed for supervisors

## Modules
1. Hazardous Materials Regulations (overview, hazard classes and divisions)
2. Hazardous Materials Table (Columns 1-10, Appendices A and B)
3. Shipping Papers
4. Packaging
5. Marking
6. Labeling
7. Placarding
8. Carrier Requirements: Highway (DOT and FMCSR)
9. Security Awareness

## Who should take it
Hazmat supervisors and managers; compliance and safety officers; fleet and logistics managers; shipping, receiving and dispatch supervisors; emergency response coordinators.
